content: {"like": ["Animation is the best of any original Yamato movies, reminiscent of Sunbow’s GI Joe: The Movie and Don Bluth.", "Music is always fantastic in Space Battleship Yamato.", "There are some amazing moments and the final moments are quite emotional.", "The film is the cleanest print among the three Yamato films released by Voyager."], "dislike": ["The film is presented in 4:3, which is not the original theatrical aspect ratio.", "The widescreen DVD version is pseudo widescreen, achieved by cutting off the top and bottom of the image, which is not good.", "The presentation of the movie in theaters is unclear and confusing.", "There is confusion about the 35mm versus 70mm versions and their runtimes."]}
